**Tier 3** — derived — a pure function of tier 2 · owned by `platform` · `public.kg_assertions`

**One row is** One fact between two entities of an organization's knowledge graph — subject, relation, object and what distinguishes it (a tier, a role, a product) — with the dates it holds and when it was first and last seen. Its status is computed from its evidence, never stored (docs/PLAN.md §29, WP 19.2).

## Uniqueness

| Columns | Source | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `kg_assertions_pkey` |
| `organization_id` + `subject_id` + `relation` + `object_id` + `qualifier_key` | UNIQUE index | `kg_assertions_natural_key` |

**Natural key:** `organization_id` + `subject_id` + `relation` + `object_id` + `qualifier_key` — the key this table's grain implies, and the
database ENFORCES it: `kg_assertions_natural_key`. A re-upload of the same row updates
it rather than duplicating it.

## Constraints

These reject the row outright. A value that fails one of them does not arrive
partially or get corrected — the write fails.

| `kg_assertions_relation_check` | `CHECK (relation IN ('SuppliesTo','Produces','LocatedIn','OwnedBy','Ships','Operates','CustomerOf'))` | `20261107000002_kg_assertions.sql` |
| `kg_assertions_qualifier_check` | `CHECK (jsonb_typeof(qualifier) = 'object')` | `20261107000002_kg_assertions.sql` |
| `kg_assertions_valid_to_check` | `CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from)` | `20261107000002_kg_assertions.sql` |

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | yes |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | **none** |

Per organization: RLS on with no policy and no grant to an API role. Facts are written by kg_record_assertion (which refuses entities or evidence from another organization) and read by kg_list_assertions, both refusing an actor outside the organization through kg_assert_org_member. Status (verified / corroborated / provisional / stale / contradicted) is computed by kg_assertion_status from distinct publisher groups, never stored. Audited at tier 3; rehearsal/970 proves independence, staleness, contradiction, the natural key and isolation. Outside the simulation (PLAN.md §29 rule 4).

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.
